name: Dual Surface Silhouette Detection
definition: A method using the notion of a dual surface to detect silhouettes, where a duality map transforms surfaces into dual space and silhouette detection is reduced to the intersection of the viewplane with the dual surface.
summary: Dual Surface Silhouette Detection identifies object silhouettes by intersecting the viewplane with a dual surface, offering a general approach for both orthographic and perspective projections unlike Gauss maps.
